mode: built-in ImageGen using original costume references
scope: Review only. All 13 original cuisine-theme illustrations animated; grouped coverage of 48 cuisine IDs. App unchanged.

themes.title: 中菜及點心 · 開心食包包
themes.description: 咬一口、鼓起面珠咀嚼，滿足眯眼，再舔舔嘴。

themes.title: 日式及拉麵 · 吸麵鼓面珠
themes.description: 筷子夾起拉麵，吹一吹再吸入口，鼓起面珠、滿足眯眼。

themes.title: 壽司 · 小師傅鞠躬
themes.description: 展示壽司盤、閉眼鞠躬，再舉起筷子。

themes.title: 韓式 · 拌飯嚐一口
themes.description: 用木匙拌飯，舀一小口品嚐，再開心眯眼點頭。

themes.title: 東南亞 · 聞香飲湯
themes.description: 聞到湯麵香味，吹涼湯匙，飲一口後露出滿足笑容。

themes.title: 咖喱 · 蘸餅舔舔嘴
themes.description: 撕起小塊薄餅蘸咖喱，食一口後可愛地舔嘴。

themes.title: 西式 · 捲意粉開餐
themes.description: 用叉捲起意粉、送入口，咀嚼後滿足眨眼。

themes.title: 燒烤 · 夾起香噴噴串燒
themes.description: 燒烤夾開合，翻一翻蔬菜串燒，聞到香味後笑眯眯。

themes.title: 素食 · 咬紅蘿蔔
themes.description: 拿起紅蘿蔔咬一口，面珠鼓起，再開心眯眼。

themes.title: 海鮮 · 嚐蝦肉眨眼
themes.description: 叉起一小口熟蝦肉，吹一吹、食入口，再滿足地眨眼。

themes.title: 火鍋 · 撈料吹一吹
themes.description: 漏勺撈起蘑菇，吹涼才品嚐，最後開心笑。

themes.title: 甜品 · 開心小跳
themes.description: 屈膝、跳起、披肩飄起，再舉起打蛋器。

themes.title: 薄餅及卷餅 · 大啖咬一口
themes.description: 拿起卷餅咬一口，鼓起面珠、舔嘴，再開心展示美食。

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D animation sprite sheet, NOT a contact sheet of unrelated poses. Reference image defines the exact same big-eyed chubby pink pig character, brown cloven hooves, round snout, curled tail, cape with gold clasp, cream apron with small Morandi roulette emblem, soft paper-watercolour illustration. Preserve identity, proportions, costume and viewpoint across every frame. Create ONE transparent PNG, exactly 2048x1024 pixels, an invisible regular grid of 4 columns x 2 rows, eight 512x512 equal square cells. Read frames left-to-right across top row then bottom row. Each cell contains exactly one whole pig at the SAME scale and registration, feet baseline y=460 within every cell except explicitly jumping; body centred x=256; leave 32px safety margin for all extended limbs and props. No cell borders, no text, no labels, no numbers, no ground, no shadows, no scenery. True transparent alpha everywhere outside the pig. All eight frames must show visibly DIFFERENT articulated poses and facial expressions of a single coherent motion, not a rigid rotated or translated copy. Exactly two arms and two legs, natural grips. Keep silhouette clear at phone size. Subtle hand-drawn squash/stretch, moving ears and cape, no stylistic drift. Morandi sage/dusty rose/cream/muted grey-blue palette, warm friendly expression. Output only the aligned eight-frame sprite atlas.
